nonclaims: Parameter drift or chart transition support

attenuation.oracle: Exact rational positive exp(q) series plus geometric tail, inverted

state.oracle: Exact Fraction bilinear extrema and independent interior points

charge.oracle: Python unbounded integer product and prefix sum

weak_premise_negative_control.required_premise: Retain every cell intersecting the exact compatible set.

illustrative_grid.oracle: Sound rational exp(-actual_dt/tau) enclosures and independent rational state interval transport, outward quantized only onto a 2^-128 oracle grid to bound audit cost.
illustrative_grid.scope: Illustrative arithmetic grid, not a claim about ADC hardware, calibrated current, physical parameters or frozen benchmark trace.
illustrative_grid.width_bound: Report exact rational (2B*h+2D)/g for active updates, h=max(A_upper-A_lower), g=min(D-A_upper)>0; zero-time exact identities excluded from contraction. This is conditional arithmetic width, not physical accuracy.

nominal_stream.reference: Independent rational exponential enclosure; state oracle outward grid 2^-128

memory.stack_aggregation_scope: Sum of all reported nonrecursive core frames is a loose own-source upper subtotal, not runtime high-water or target ABI qualification.
memory.scope: One instance per isolated primitive. Parameter-cell storage, certificate producer, acquisition, chronology/recovery, call runtime and full estimator are excluded.
